posts.title: Running Arch Linux on the Framework Laptop 13
posts.description: This article sums up why and how I run Arch Linux on my Framework Laptop 13, which I received on the 3rd of July 2023, and am still as of today happily using!

posts.title: Uninterupted desktop streaming vs. NetworkManager
posts.description: For maybe more than a year (maybe two) I’ve been struggling with getting desktop streaming (i.e., from a Linux desktop client to a Windows or Linux host system) working flawlessly. I mean, without interruptions in video frame speed (60fps) or audio drop-outs.
